toolFinder.title: Toolbox & Quick Finder
toolFinder.searchPlaceholder: Search all tools (e.g. page numbers, rotate, merge, table, sanitize, compress...)
toolFinder.tip: Press ⌘K or click Finder for quick launch

tools.mergeDesc: Combine multiple PDF files into one single document
tools.splitDesc: Separate a PDF into individual pages or ranges
tools.rotateDesc: Rotate pages clockwise or counterclockwise by 90°, 180°, or 270°
tools.deleteDesc: Remove unwanted pages permanently from the document
tools.extractDesc: Save selected pages as an independent new PDF
tools.compressDesc: Optimize streams and fonts to reduce file size without losing clarity
tools.watermarkDesc: Add custom text or angled security watermark across all pages
tools.img2pdfDesc: Convert multiple JPG/PNG images into a single PDF
tools.pdf2imgDesc: Export high-resolution PDF pages as PNG images
tools.pdf2textDesc: Extract raw text content from the entire document or range
tools.signDesc: Place transparent digital signature images on any page
tools.ocrDesc: Recognize text from scanned/image PDFs using offline neural network
tools.ocrEditDesc: Recognize text on current page and edit/replace it in-place
tools.editTextDesc: Click anywhere to type and place vector text
tools.editRectDesc: Draw customized bordered or filled rectangle shapes
tools.editHighlightDesc: Add colored translucent highlights over important contents
tools.extractTableDesc: Detect tables automatically and export to CSV or Markdown
tools.reorderDesc: Drag and drop thumbnails to rearrange document page order
tools.insertPagesDesc: Seamlessly insert pages from another PDF at specified index
tools.pageNumberDesc: Batch add header/footer numbering with flexible format templates
tools.sanitizeDesc: Strip author, creator, XMP streams, and private editing histories
tools.batchDesc: Apply operations to multiple PDF files at once
